The decisive mistake was made by Clinical_Trial_Data_Analysis_Expert at step 5. It reported an actual enrollment of 100 participants, but the correct figure is 90. The agent had no tool call in the log and appeared to supply the number without actually retrieving it from the NIH page. The Validation_Expert then repeated that figure without real verification, and the other agents agreed, so the error originated at step 5.
